label: the case system itself: eight cases doing what Spanish does with prepositions and order
note: Sanskrit-specific, and the single biggest thing the proxy cannot ask for. Spanish marks roles with word order and prepositions; Sanskrit marks them on the noun, and until a learner has that, no sentence parses. The track teaches the locative in chapter 5 and the dative of purpose in chapter 4 before naming the families in chapter 16.
